scope: R10 explicit full notification renderer and circle drag/gesture; narrow equivalent oneshot overhead only; closed authorities unchanged

daemon.before:
publish_uperf_rules_state() {
    rules=
    while read -r rule_pkg rule_mode extra; do
        [ -z "$extra" ] || continue
        case "$rule_pkg" in ''|'#'*|'-'|'*') continue ;; esac
        valid_package_name "$rule_pkg" || continue
        valid_uperf_preset "$rule_mode" || continue
        rules="${rules}${rule_pkg}|${rule_mode}
"
    done < "$UPERF_PERAPP" 2>/dev/null
    settings_put_quiet "$UPERF_RULES_KEY" "$(printf '%s' "$rules" | sed '/^$/d')" || return 1
    UPERF_RULES_DIRTY=0
}

        if [ -n "$rules" ]; then
            rules="$rules
$rule_pkg|$rule_mode"
        else
            rules="$rule_pkg|$rule_mode"
        fi
    done < "$UPERF_PERAPP" 2>/dev/null

daemon.before:
process_settings_request() {
    if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
        request="$1"
    else
        request="$(settings_get_clean "$REQ_TEXT_KEY")"
    fi
    [ -n "$request" ] || return 0
    if [ "$request" = "$LAST_SETTINGS_REQUEST" ]; then
        publish_pending_terminal_ack >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        return 0
    fi
    id="${request%%'|'*}"
    if [ -n "$LAST_COMPLETED_REQUEST_ID" ] && [ "$id" = "$LAST_COMPLETED_REQUEST_ID" ]; then
        if [ "$request" = "$replay_request" ]; then
            publish_pending_terminal_ack >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
        else
            TERMINAL_ACK_PENDING=0
        fi
        LAST_SETTINGS_REQUEST="$request"
        return 0
    fi
    request_tail="${request#*'|'}"; cmd="${request_tail%%'|'*}"
    request_tail="${request_tail#*'|'}"; request_tail="${request_tail#*'|'}"
    pkg="${request_tail%%'|'*}"; mode="${request_tail#*'|'}"
    count_request_fields "$request"
    if [ "$field_count" != "5" ] || [ -z "$id" ] || [ -z "$cmd" ]; then
        finish_request "$request" "${id:-invalid}" "${cmd:-invalid}" 1 invalid_request
        return $?
    fi
    CURRENT_REQUEST_ID="$id"
    CURRENT_REQUEST_CMD="$cmd"
    publish_request_progress validating
    case "$cmd" in
        zo_*) log_line "request id=$id cmd=$cmd bounded_transport=1" ;;
        *) log_line "request id=$id cmd=$cmd pkg=$pkg mode=$mode" ;;
    esac
    if ! persist_request_claim "$request"; then
        log_line "request claim failed id=$id cmd=$cmd; action not started"
        return 1
    fi
    timing_mark "$id" T5 "$cmd"
    handle_command "$cmd" "$pkg" "$mode"
    result=$?
    timing_mark "$id" T6 "$cmd"
    trim_log
    finish_request "$request" "$id" "$cmd" "$result" "$REQUEST_RESULT_DETAIL"
}
